title: Chapter 781
paragraphs: Chapter 781
Episode 192. The Event from Three Days Ago (2)
'Show where the Family Head is...!? What is happening?'
Although she couldn't comprehend what was being said, an ominous intuition stabbed Octavia's mind like a knife.
Threatened by the tremendous fire in Huroti's grasp, Octavia backed off. The fight between Beradin and Kadun had begun too quickly for her to intercede.
Whoosh-!

The flame on the wand transformed into a massive fireball in an instant. The second form of the annihilating flame of the Demon King, a great spell used by Kelliac in the past when he attacked the Yellow Emperor.
However, unlike before, Beradin did not transform into a form similar to Kelliac. He remained young and was using Kelliac's magic.
[Beradin, you finally show your true colors…!]
Kadun, disbelieving, widened his eyes and yelled. He found it hard to believe that Beradin, without any warning, could unleash such a powerful force, and was truly intending to attack him.
Moreover, Beradin was not even using the help of the Magic Stone. He had unfolded the great spell purely with his own magic power.
"That's what I should be saying, Kadun. I should have realized sooner that you're no longer necessary for the family. No, beyond that, you're actually a harmful existence."
Kwoaaaa-!
Gathering all his strength, Kadun exhaled. Unlike the beam-like breath, from Kadun's mouth erupted a fireball of the same gigantic size as the second form.
As the two fireballs clashed, the resulting shockwave caused the remaining mages to quickly form a protective shield.
The sheer firepower of Beradin's second form exceeded the final form.

Therefore, like what Jin did during the Yellow Emperor War, finding and cutting off the flow of magic was the best countermeasure. Knowing the secret of the second form like Jin, Kadun quickly descended to lower his altitude. His movements were momentarily concealed by the explosion of the fireballs.
But at the very moment when he was about to check the flow of the second form by releasing his magical power.
Two beams suddenly flew from both sides and pierced Kadun like spears. Kadun, surprised by the unexpected attack, had no choice but to retreat, wrapping his body with his wings.
'Damn it, I was so excited that I forgot about them…!'
The water dragon of the Water God Itelmyon, Tuyan, and the earth dragon of the Earth God Likta, Phinia. The ones that ambushed Kadun were Beradin's guardian dragons.
[Tuyan, Phinia. You've grown a lot. Have you gone mad with the Family Head? It should be your duty as guardian dragons to help the Family Head make the right decisions.]
Tuyan and Phinia did not respond but closed the distance, pressing Kadun.
This was strange.
The two dragons' combat capabilities far exceeded Cadun's memories. The Tuyan and Finia that Cadun knew wouldn't even be able to move properly in this kind of flame.
However, the two dragons continued to charge at Cadun, biting at him while withstanding the flame with their bodies.
[Kaak!]
Soon, Cadun's shoulder was ripped apart by Tuyan's sharp teeth. Thud! A scale and flesh the size of a human body fell to the floor, making a heavy sound.
It was no different from the sound of Cadun's honor and prestige falling. The symbolic significance Cadun had in Zifl was 'the ultimate force'.

He had let his guard down, forgetting about the existence of the guardian dragons, but it was staggering to see such a figure being pushed back so fruitlessly. The battle had not yet been a minute since it started.
Octavia was also taken aback. She had not anticipated Cadun being pushed back this easily.
Of course, the fight isn't over yet.
Nevertheless, Veradin amplified the flames of type 2 even more, his voice was cold.
"Will you continue? By the way, I have no hesitation in killing you, Cadun. If you surrender now, I'll think about how to use your arrogant body and inner self for the family."
[Shut up!]
"Oh, well...... Since you believe in a certain part, you won't stop. But soon you'll realize that even that was all wrong."
[What are you babbling about......!]
"But why is the Ghost Captain just watching? Or do you need more time to decide which side to take?"
Octavia flinched as she locked eyes with Veradin.
Her inner self felt as if it was tightly squeezed by an unknown fear.
"That's..."
"All the other magicians have finished preparing their attacks."
When she looked around, she saw that the magicians of the Magic Tower were repairing their shields and launching ring magic.

The magicians deployed to the First Magic Tower of Zifl, the Tower of Stories, are all experts of the White Night level. Many retired Ghost Captains and members of the anti-magic family were stationed there.

In Octavia's view, their loyalty should have been more inclined towards Cadun than the current owner who has been wielding too much power lately. Especially the retired Ghost Captains were characters who prioritized their own orders over the owner's.
Nevertheless, they were all trying to hit Cadun following Veradin, without a moment's hesitation. All of them had their eyes shining bright white.
Octavia guessed for a moment why they had turned into 'white eyes'.
'A large-scale mental manipulation……!?'
She had never seen this level of dark magic in person, but she instinctively recognized it. Veradin was controlling the magicians like puppets through mental manipulation.
Veradin spoke with his eyes. The reason I didn't use this magic on you is a final act of consideration.

"Mind manipulation is not only your privilege, it is also that of the Gipil, Ghost Captain. So, there's no need to be surprised. Now hurry and move, we need to finish off Kadun as quickly as possible."
Veradin extended his arm as if suggesting she should step forward first.
In the end, Octavia had no choice but to aim at Kadun, pouring magic into her staff. Kadun was already being crushed by the two dragons and was struggling on the ground.
'... Please forgive me, Kadun. As of now, I have no choice but to follow the clan leader's orders.'
First, she had to follow Veradin's words and attack Kadun.
Next, she had to somehow keep Kadun alive and wait for Kelliac to return. If the clan leader returns, all of these crazy situations will surely be sorted out correctly.
There was still no response from the top floor of the tower.
As Octavia's light magic began to form, Kadun howled in anger even more.
"Octavia Gipil! So, you are also following the madman's orders. The glory of the Gipil, which has lasted for thousands of years, is tarnished today!"
When Octavia and the wizards joined in, Kadun was barely able to defend himself. His furious roar echoed emptily across the battlefield.
In this way, about ten minutes passed.
Kadun, who had been shaking with the reputation of the strongest fire dragon, finally collapsed on the ground with his body torn to pieces.
He was panting with a metallic sound, his wings half torn and spread, and his blood was forming puddles here and there on the ground.
On the other hand, the damage on Veradin's side was virtually none. Tuyan and Pinia were injured, but they could recover in a few days.
Even excluding Veradin's ability, it was impossible for Kadun to attack the Tower of Stories alone and win.
"If the wizards had rebelled with Lord Kadun, the result might have been a bit different, but it's bland. Is this the power with which you have been overpowering me?"
Veradin spoke while tapping Kadun's forehead with his staff. It was a sight that could not be more humiliating.
"Veradin......"
"I've given you the chance to correct your mistakes several times, Lord Kadun."
"Why are you doing this to me? Because I showed displeasure towards you?"
"Of course, that's included, but you're still in denial. I must acknowledge your thick skin. You're too damaged to keep alive. It's time to say goodbye. Do you want to leave a will?"
"If I die, Kelliac and Shinoo will... Ku... Aaaack!"
Veradin's staff slowly began to penetrate Kadun's forehead.
The wizards who had turned a blind eye remained motionless at the sight, but Octavia was on the verge of despair, her heart aching.

"Lord Sovereign! Although Lord Kadun's injuries are severe, there will be no problem fighting for the family again once he is healed. Lord Kadun must have learned a lot from today's incident, can't we just stop here? For the sake of our Lord and the God of the family, Shinu, please...!”
Thunk!
Veradin's staff pierced through Kadun's forehead. Sticky blood flowed down the staff.
"No!"
The moment Octavia screamed.
Suddenly, a gloomy vibration began to shake the entire sky and ground.
It was the magical tower. The vibrations were spreading from the top floor, where Kelriak's maintenance device was located.
Kwooooong!
Soon, the top floor of the magic tower was exploding. In the midst of despair, Octavia turned and looked up at the tower.
'This, this aura is...!'
It was the energy of the Family Head, Kelriak Zipel.
However, the aura was giving off a slightly different atmosphere from Octavia's memory. A black aura full of malice, that could never be human, was pouring out of the tower.
It was a soul aura. Along with the flames symbolizing Kelriak, a horrifying soul aura like that of an evil spirit was already darkening the sky of the magic tower.
"Lord Sovereign, what on earth is happening... How could our Lord..."
At the same time, a soul aura began to flow from Kadun, who seemed to have just passed away. Veradin stepped back with Octavia, casting a protective shield.
"Until now, the Fire Dragon Kadun had been amplifying my father's soul aura. I don't know what the intent was, but I judged that it would never have a good influence on the family."
"No, no way! Lord Kadun would never do that."

"Look, as soon as Kadun's life was in danger, didn't my father immediately start rampaging? Even if it's hard to accept, this was the reality our family was facing. It means that both the root and the pillar were rotten."
Growwwl!
Kelriak, filled with clear hostility, was roaring. Kelriak, revealed among the debris of the broken top floor of the tower, looked like a terrifying demon.
Behind him, Kadun was spreading his wings again. The wizards were regrouping, Tuwan and Phinia sat down on either side of Veradin, preparing for battle.
"If Kadun's evil plan had been completed as planned, we wouldn't have been able to handle our monstrous father."
"Lord Sovereign, you can't mean... What are you planning to do with our Lord now!?"
At Octavia's words, Veradin responded without a moment's hesitation.
"We have to kill him. Fortunately, I will be able to give him rest myself today, before he becomes another evil spirit."
